failure_modes: Model defaulted to a generic explosion/release template: it overfilled optional nodes with unsupported or "Not specified" entries, treated observed manifestations (overpressure/explosion/release) as causal events, and ignored upstream mechanistic cause information available in same-incident analysis sections. It also chose released byproducts instead of the direct triggering material, and copied hazard-consequence evidence that was not a clean direct quote.
patch_rules: 1. Only emit nodes that are required by the SCHEMA or clearly supported and causally essential; do not add optional nodes just to say "Not specified". 2. Do not use consequence/manifestation wording (overpressure, explosion, blast, ejection) as the InitiatingEvent when the report provides an upstream mechanism; prefer the earliest causal abnormal mechanism. 3. If same-incident analysis/cause sections describe a direct precursor chain, use them to define InitiatingEvent and MechanicalFailure, and you may summarize tightly linked precursor steps into one initiating event. 4. For confined internal explosion/overpressure scenarios, do not assume a separate release/dispersion/ignition sequence; omit IgnitionSource, ReleaseType, Dispersion, IntermediateEvent, etc. unless explicitly evidenced and required. 5. Select the single material that directly triggers the hazard consequence; derive Phase/Volatility from that selected material, not from all emitted materials. 6. If IDENTIFIED_HAZARD_CONSEQUENCE evidence is paraphrased or non-verbatim, keep the node identity but replace evidence with a short direct quote from the incident text.
revised_prompt_suffix:
ADDITIONAL DISAMBIGUATION RULES

- If the incident_description JSON includes same-incident physical-cause or analysis sections, use them when needed to identify the upstream mechanism; do not stop at the first observed manifestation in the narrative.
- Prefer a sparse scenario. Include only nodes that are schema-required or strongly supported as part of the realized causal chain. Do not populate optional fields/events/entities with placeholder "Not specified" unless the schema requires that field.
- For InitiatingEvent, choose the earliest upstream abnormal mechanism, not a manifestation such as "overpressure," "explosion," "blast," or "release," if a more causal precursor is described.
- For confined internal overpressure/explosion events, do not create a generic external release/dispersion/ignition template unless the report explicitly supports those elements.
- Choose one hazardous material that most directly causes the hazard consequence; if an ingress material (for example, leaking water entering hot equipment) directly drives the overpressure, select that material rather than later ejected contents. Then make Phase/Volatility consistent with that chosen material.
- For hazard_consequence evidence as well, prefer a short exact quote from the report; if the provided node's evidence is not verbatim, replace only the evidence text with a direct quote while preserving the hazard_consequence identity.
